description.p: Salt opens a comic archive or a folder of images and scrolls through the set, down the page or side by side. There is no menu bar or toolbar: everything lives in the right-click menu, including Preferences, where the window can turn translucent with KWin's blur behind it.

ul.li: Opens .cbz, .cbr, .zip and .tar archives (plain, gzip, bzip2 or xz), or a folder of images, recognising misnamed archives by their contents
Reads vertically or side by side, fits to width, height or both, and scrolls continuously or a page at a time
Decodes pages on demand, so memory stays flat however long the set is
Spots part-downloaded archives, and points out a zip of issues or a folder of chapters
Fullscreen, and a minimal mode that hides the status bar
Opens files dragged onto the window, and says why one won't open instead of closing
